definitions.sample: fixed-seed (20151027+year) uniform sample of halfcourt attempts
definitions.grid: 1ft bins over LOC_X [-250,250], LOC_Y [-50,420], tenths of feet
definitions.resolution.rim_sentinel: the single most-filed coordinate among the season's restricted-area shots, with how far it leads the runner-up. `origin_snapped` beside it counts EXACTLY (0,0) and is therefore blind to a refusal filed anywhere else - which is what six seasons do. `is_refusal` reads `lead_ratio` against 8, chosen from the middle of an empty band: across the corpus the lead is either about 2x or 18x and higher, with nothing between, so any threshold from roughly 3 to 15 classifies every season identically. CORROBORATED AGAINST A SECOND INSTRUMENT, and the piece says these shots were refused a place only because it is: 2015-16's pile is the one this archive can be asked about twice, because that season is both one of the six that file a displaced pile and the season the public SportVU tracking release covers. The record files the whole pile on one coordinate; the optical feed puts the shots it can see in very nearly one position each, no more concentrated than dunks the record placed individually, and at the same distance from the rim - so the coordinate is a filing convention and not a location. The evidence is the SHOOTER'S FEET, which the join between the two instruments never constrains. Read the figures, the like-for-like control and the method from window.json under `sentinel_corroboration`. SCOPE, and it is a real limit rather than a footnote: ONE of the six seasons, and a minority of even that season's pile. The other five are uncorroborated and no source available today can corroborate them - every one of them is another read of the same database
definitions.resolution.ra_origin_share: restricted-area shots filed at exactly (0,0). For twenty-four of the thirty seasons that IS the record declining to say where at the rim, and it is the figure every earlier reading of this archive was made from. For the six seasons that file their refusal elsewhere it reports 0.0% or a handful of stragglers and measures nothing - read `rim_sentinel`, which is what the pin, the regime and the arena spread are all taken from now
definitions.resolution.regime: how the record placed rim shots that season, classified from `rim_sentinel` rather than from the exact origin: `uneven` when the spread across arenas reaches 40 percentage points (the refusal is a property of the BUILDING), `uniformly_sighted` when the sentinel refuses at most 2% of rim shots, `uniformly_blind` when it swallows 50% or more of them, and `categorical_refusal` for the band between - a named category of shot the taxonomy declines to place. `rim_sentinel.kind` divides that band further, and is measured rather than labelled here
definitions.resolution.rim_sentinel.composition: the record's own names for what sits on the sentinel, with `share_of_pile` and - the measurement the reading rests on - `share_of_type`, how much of the season's WHOLE population of that name the pile holds. A name whose season sits almost entirely on one cell is a name the record never placed
definitions.resolution.rim_sentinel.kind: which refusal this is, from two measured bands rather than by eye. `wholesale` when the pile is 50% or more of the rim (measured: either 8-15% or 73-95% of it, nothing between); otherwise `dunk` when the pile converts at 0.775 or better and `tip_putback` when it does not (measured: either .552-.642 or .9085-.9124, nothing between). The composition beside it says the same thing in the record's own words, so the label rests on two independent readings. null when the busiest rim coordinate is not a refusal at all
definitions.resolution.full_resolution_arenas: home arenas whose games recorded real rim coordinates that season; through 2009-10 only five or six did, and it follows the building, not the team
definitions.contemporaneous: 1996-97 only: mid-range recomputed under the 22-ft line then in force, against the modern polygons SHOT_ZONE_BASIC applies retroactively. `line_ft` is that line's radius - external history no dump records - and both the words the piece prints and the arc it draws for 1996-97 read it from here
definitions.schema: the dump's own header, counted: how many fields the record keeps per shot and how many positions among them. Asserted constant across all thirty seasons - the vocabulary grows, the schema does not
definitions.classification_place: where each of the record's own categories sits on the floor: the mean of SHOT_DISTANCE and the CIRCULAR mean of atan2(LOC_Y, LOC_X), over that category's PLACED shots only - shots filed on `rim_sentinel` are the pin's and are excluded, which for six seasons is NOT the origin. Polar rather than Cartesian because the centroid of an annular category lands outside the band it is named for. `n` is the category's whole count and `n_placed` how many of them the record gave a place, so a summary resting on a minority of its own shots declares it. NOT clipped to the halfcourt: the three backcourt categories land beyond the plate in every season, and that is the record naming ground this plate cannot hold
definitions.vocabulary.covering_90pct: how many categories of each taxonomy account for 90% of the season's shots. THE CENSUS strikes exactly these into the floor and THE LEDGER's label budget is the DESCRIPTION entry, so the two hands' text density is one measurement rather than two

contemporaneous.note: the 3PT line stood at 22 ft in 1994-97; SHOT_ZONE_BASIC applies the modern 23'9" geometry retroactively, filing these attempts as Mid-Range
